name: Eyes of the Gods
body:
Your faith allows you to spot undead without fail.

Prerequisite(s): Wis 13, cleric or 3rd-level paladin

Benefit: You may use divination spells, such as detect undead or true seeing, to detect resurrected or reincarnated characters.
